desc: Build the tree structure (adjacency list) and determine parent-child relationships using BFS from root 0, also computing the distance from root for each node.
Implement a DFS function that traverses the tree, maintaining a `last_seen` dictionary that records the distance from root for the most recent occurrence of each value on the current path.
In the DFS, for each node, calculate the start distance of the special path ending at this node by looking up `last_seen[nums[node]]`, update the global maximum length and minimum node count.
Update `last_seen[nums[node]]` to the current node's distance from root, recurse to all children, and then backtrack by restoring `last_seen[nums[node]]` to its previous value.
Initialize global variables for `max_length` and `min_nodes`, run the DFS from root, and return the result array `[max_length, min_nodes]`.
